transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to get us together to work through the disposal authorization for those fourteen 55-gallon drums of spent coolant currently staged in the waste staging area. As you know, our waste-authorization routine requires a round-robin review with laboratory quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision before I can approve the removal plan. The disposal vendor still hasn't received authorization, so I'd like to move this forward efficiently. Let's start by making sure we all have a shared picture of what's in those drums and how they're currently being handled. Who would like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. My laboratory analysis on those drums, completed yesterday, found 2.4% chlorinated solvent in the spent coolant. Under our site's waste matrix, any batch at or above 1.0% chlorinated solvent has to go to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. That result hasn't been attached to the waste authorization file yet, so I want to make sure everyone here is aware before we settle on a disposal route.
